name: Concert Radar
description: Aggregates upcoming concerts for the artists in your Jellyfin music library from multiple sources (Ticketmaster, Bandsintown, EdmTrain, Songkick, Dice.fm, Resident Advisor), normalizes them, and surfaces them in admin and user-accessible views. Requires Jellyfin 12. The Concerts entry in the web client's avatar menu additionally needs Plugin Pages (3.0.0.0 or later) and File Transformation. See the project README.
overview: Upcoming concerts for artists in your music library.
